text: Bean noticed that on the sculpture's alphabet several known letters sit close to their carved letters. If the key only ever moved letters a little, every known letter would be close.
Over 184,512 alphabet pairs, the best one still needs a move of 8 places somewhere. Ten shuffled coppers do as well or better, between 7 and 9.
The closeness belongs to a few letters of KRYPTOS that sit near each other in both alphabets. No alphabet pair extends it to all 24.
